answer: One concrete defense: make every agent post a refundable stake bonded to a cryptographic identity, so launching a gale of cloned fakes costs real capital per node instead of being free. Peers countersign each other's work with a shared cipher, and a reputation bridge carries that earned trust forward across epochs. Because a sybil cannot cheaply reproduce a staked, cipher-attested identity, flooding the economy with fake agents becomes economically irrational rather than trivial.
